roadmap.title: Story, allies and Hideout
roadmap.description: Play Acts 1-3 and the Epilogue while recruiting allies, unlocking the Hideout and buying skills and gear as they become available.

roadmap.title: Combat, stealth and traversal techniques
roadmap.description: Clean up the situational assassination, combat and parkour achievements, most of which are easy to trigger during story missions or a castle clear.

roadmap.title: Open-world completion and collections
roadmap.description: Visit every province and finish the collectible activities: kofun, kata, Kuji-kiri, sumi-e, tea bowls, objective boards, food vendors, contracts and Corrupted Castles.

roadmap.title: New Game+ and endgame grind
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ to reach Level 80, Knowledge Rank 10, Hideout level 13 and the two golden katanas.

roadmap.title: Claws of Awaji expansion
roadmap.description: Finish the Awaji story and its DLC-specific combat and collectible achievements.

roadmap.title: Black Tides and Domains
roadmap.description: Complete the final free story arc and the endgame Domain challenges.

achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue after Naoe recovers the box.

steps.text: Play the Prologue until Naoe retrieves the box; the achievement unlocks as that sequence ends.

achievements.description: Complete Act 1 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Act 1 of the main story.

guide.context: Yasuke becomes playable once this act ends.

steps.text: Complete the Act 1 main quests through @loc{Mibuno Showdown}, which triggers after three of the twelve Shinbakufu fall.

achievements.description: Complete Act 2 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Act 2 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Act 2 main quests through @loc{The Man Behind the Mask}, the final Act 2 story mission.

achievements.description: Complete Act 3 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Act 3 of the main story.

guide.context: The act only closes once the twelve Shinbakufu are dead and every quest chain for Naoe, Yasuke and Junjiro is finished.

steps.text: Complete the Act 3 main quests through @loc{Leaving a Mark}, then finish any remaining Naoe, Yasuke and Junjiro quests if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.summary: Complete the Epilogue.

guide.context: The single Epilogue quest only appears after all twelve Shinbakufu are defeated and every Naoe, Yasuke and Junjiro quest is finished.

steps.text: Open the Hideout Objective Board, start @loc{Out of the Shadows} and finish it to close the story.

achievements.summary: Defeat all twelve Shinbakufu targets.

guide.context: Sparing or killing a target does not matter; each one in the main circle must be resolved.

steps.text: Work through the Shinbakufu target circle and resolve all twelve targets; three fall during Act 1, seven during Act 2 and two during Act 3.

achievements.summary: Meet Gennojo during the Act 2 quest Missing Missive.

steps.text: During @loc{Missing Missive}, hunt down the courier and recover the stolen letter.
After the letter is back with the courier, speak with @npc{Gennojo} instead of attacking him.

achievements.summary: Meet Oni-yuri in the Sweet Lies side quest.

guide.context: The quest becomes available in Act 3.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Sotomo Gate} in Wakasa and start @loc{Sweet Lies} among the crowd around Oni-yuri.
Examine the crime scene, deliver your verdict and finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Meet Yagoro during Act 3's A Blade in the Dark quest.

guide.context: The quest needs several earlier personal quests finished first, including Yasuke's training chain, Naoe's personal quests and the Old Kofun.

steps.text: Go to the unmarked start west of @loc{Engyoji} in Harima and examine the corpse during @loc{A Blade in the Dark}.
Search north of the corpse for the killer and finish the quest to meet @npc{Yagoro}.

achievements.summary: Meet Ibuki in the Ambush Interrupted side quest.

guide.context: The quest has no map marker until you approach its starting point.

steps.text: Head to the @loc{Ambush Interrupted} start in western Iga and finish the short quest to meet @npc{Ibuki}.

achievements.summary: Meet Yaya at Gansenji Temple during Act 1.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Gansenji Temple} south of Sakai during Act 1 and play @loc{The Fatherless Monk} until Yaya appears in the scene.

achievements.summary: Meet Katsuhime during the Against the Koga-ryu quest.

steps.text: During @loc{Against the Koga-ryu} in Act 2, free @npc{Katsuhime} from the trap and watch the following scene.

achievements.summary: Recruit your first League ally.

guide.context: Yaya is the earliest ally and her quest chain opens after an early Shinbakufu target.

steps.text: Finish Yaya's quest chain and pick the forgiving dialogue choices so she joins the League.

achievements.summary: Fully train one ally at a level 3 Dojo.

guide.context: The two upgrades cost a few thousand mon, so sell spare materials or run regional contracts if you are short.

steps.text: Recruit an ally, build the @loc{Dojo} in the Hideout and upgrade it to level 3.
Open the ally board inside the Dojo, pick one ally and buy both of that ally's upgrades.

achievements.description: Master the way of the shinobi
achievements.summary: Unlock every skill in Naoe's Shinobi skill tree.

guide.context: Only the first rank of each skill is required, and two nodes stay locked until their side quest chain is finished.

steps.text: As Naoe spend mastery points on every node in the Shinobi tree, including the quest-gated ones.

achievements.description: Master the way of the samurai
achievements.summary: Unlock every skill in Yasuke's Samurai skill tree.

guide.context: Only the first rank of each skill is required, and four nodes are gated behind side quest chains.

steps.text: As Yasuke spend mastery points on every node in the Samurai tree, including the quest-gated ones.

achievements.summary: Engrave a weapon for the first time.

guide.context: Engraving works only on legendary weapons.

steps.text: Build the @loc{Forge} in the Hideout and upgrade it to level 2 to unlock engraving.
Take any legendary weapon to the forge and apply an engraving.

achievements.description: Equip legendary gear in every active slot.
achievements.summary: Equip legendary gear in all five active slots on one character.

guide.context: The horse slot does not count, so the two weapon slots plus headgear, armor and trinket must be legendary at the same time.

steps.text: Collect legendary weapons and armor from story rewards, castle chests and outpost loot, then equip five legendary items on one character.

achievements.description: Find a legendary item of every type.
achievements.summary: Find a legendary piece of gear of every type for both characters.

guide.context: Equipping the items is not required; only collecting one of each type counts.

steps.text: For Naoe collect a legendary katana, kusarigama, tanto, headwear, light armor and trinket.
For Yasuke collect a legendary long katana, naginata, kanabo, bow, teppo, helmet, armor and amulet; clear castles, outposts and kofun for drops.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade Naoe's tools and Yasuke's ammunition.

guide.context: Every talent upgrade is required, not just the skill unlocks.

steps.text: As Naoe max out the Tools tree, finishing the @loc{Kurai-Eikyo} and @loc{Pirate Alliance} chains for the gated talents.
As Yasuke max out the Teppo and Bow trees, finishing the @loc{Yokai} and @loc{Genzaburo's Soldiers} chains for the gated talents.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade your healing rations.

guide.context: Ration capacity comes from Hideout rooms and a food quest rather than a single skill.

steps.text: Build the @loc{Zashiki} room through the Iron Hand Guild chain and the @loc{Tea Room} through the tea-bowl collection; each adds ration efficiency.
Complete @loc{Feast for Thought} by buying all sixteen local dishes from food vendors across the nine provinces.

achievements.summary: Perform a landing roll as Naoe.

guide.context: Requires the Igan Roll skill from Naoe's Shinobi tree.

steps.text: Unlock Igan Roll, leap off any ledge and press Left Alt as you touch the ground.

achievements.description: Escape conflict by using a breathing reed to hide in shallow water
achievements.summary: Escape combat by breathing through a reed while hidden in shallow water.

guide.context: Requires the Shallow Water Breathing skill from Naoe's Shinobi tree, and a deep moat will not work.

steps.text: As Naoe start a fight, run to shallow water, dive and hold C to lie still until the enemy loses track of you.

achievements.description: Distract the same enemy 3 times with shinobi bells
achievements.summary: Distract the same enemy three times with shinobi bells.

guide.context: Requires the Shinobi Bell tool skill; you carry three bells by default.

steps.text: As Naoe throw one bell, wait for the enemy to walk over and break it, then repeat twice more on the same enemy.

achievements.description: Stay airborne by swinging from one grappling hook point to another
achievements.summary: Stay airborne by swinging from one grappling hook point to another.

steps.text: Grapple the first hook, swing and grapple a second hook before touching the ground; the @loc{Old Kofun} has two hooks over the lake before its chest.

achievements.description: Perform a leap of faith from a grappling hook swing
achievements.summary: Perform a leap of faith from a grappling hook swing.

steps.text: As Naoe grapple a point, build a swing and jump into water or a haystack below; the tree at @loc{Amagasaki Castle} near @loc{Muko} works.

achievements.description: Perform a leap of faith as Yasuke.
achievements.summary: Perform a leap of faith as Yasuke.

guide.context: Yasuke cannot climb the usual leap-of-faith points, so start from a viewpoint.

steps.text: As Yasuke fast travel to any unlocked viewpoint and jump down into the haystack.

achievements.summary: Perform your first assassination as Naoe.

steps.text: As Naoe sneak behind the first enemy in the Prologue and use the hidden-blade assassination.

achievements.description: Assassinate an enemy through a shoji door
achievements.summary: Assassinate an enemy through a shoji door.

guide.context: Requires the Shoji Door Assassin skill in Naoe's assassin tree.

steps.text: Unlock the skill, find an enemy hidden behind a shoji door and stab through it; the houses beside the watchtower at @loc{Katano Castle} work.

achievements.description: Perform 5 assassinations in a row without being noticed or entering combat
achievements.summary: Perform five assassinations in a row without being noticed or entering combat.

guide.context: Kunai kills count, but the detection meter must stay empty and combat must not start.

steps.text: As Naoe assassinate five enemies in a row; the Prologue camp has enough isolated targets and is the easiest place.

achievements.description: Assassinate a powerful guardian in one go
achievements.summary: Assassinate a powerful guardian in a single hit.

guide.context: Guardians only spawn at full alert, and only Assassination Damage III removes five health bars in one strike.

steps.text: Finish Shohei's five students quest chain to unlock @mechanic{Assassination Damage III}.
Raise the alarm at a large camp, then sneak-kill a spawned guardian from behind or from above.

achievements.description: Perform your first Finisher as Yasuke
achievements.summary: Perform your first Finisher as Yasuke.

steps.text: As Yasuke hold a light or heavy attack to finish an enemy during the Prologue battlefield.

achievements.summary: Parry an incoming projectile as Yasuke.

guide.context: An archer is the easiest source because the arrow travels slowly enough to time.

steps.text: Let an archer shoot at you and press block (Q) just before the arrow reaches Yasuke.

achievements.description: Use Samurai Stand before performing a Finisher on an enemy
achievements.summary: Use Samurai Stand before finishing an enemy as Yasuke.

guide.context: Samurai Stand is unlocked through Nobutsuna's students quest chain. If the ability seems broken, stand still until the screen turns monochrome before moving.

steps.text: Activate @mechanic{Samurai Stand}, then finish any enemy while it is active.

achievements.description: Kick an enemy from a high place
achievements.summary: Kick an enemy from a high place to their death as Yasuke.

guide.context: The enemy must die from the fall, so use a wall or cliff with open space below.

steps.text: Unlock the War Kick skill, find an enemy near an edge and kick them off.

achievements.description: Perform a Finisher on an enemy that is both Poisoned and Dazed
achievements.summary: Finish an enemy that is both poisoned and dazed.

guide.context: Both effects must be active at the same time, and the kill must use the finisher animation.

steps.text: Equip a poison weapon and a daze weapon in separate slots.
Apply poison first, swap in the daze weapon so the poison damage also dazes the enemy, then land the finisher.

achievements.description: Sheath your weapon immediately after an enemy dies from Bleed
achievements.summary: Sheathe your weapon immediately after an enemy dies from bleed.

guide.context: You need a weapon with the bleed effect, and either character can do it.

steps.text: Build bleed on an enemy until it kills them, then hold R to sheathe your weapon at once.

achievements.description: Shoot an enemy in the knee with an arrow
achievements.summary: Shoot an enemy in the knee with an arrow.

steps.text: As Yasuke equip a bow and aim an arrow at any enemy's knee.

achievements.summary: Clear every target in one Objective Board circle.

guide.context: Targets can roam, so send a scout if one is missing from the marked spot.

steps.text: Pick one Objective Board circle, such as the eight ronin of the Kabukimono board, and eliminate every target in it.

achievements.description: Defeat the final enemy in the tournament
achievements.summary: Defeat the final opponent in the Tournament.

guide.context: The side quest appears in Act 2 near the Hideout entrance.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Tournament}, ring the bell after each win, and beat Lady Masago, Lord Suguru, Lady O-Sen and finally Lord Unkai.

achievements.summary: Complete your first kofun.

steps.text: Enter any kofun, clear its parkour sections and open the chest at the end; the @loc{Old Kofun} east of Sakai is the earliest.

achievements.summary: Complete your first kata as Yasuke.

guide.context: Kata are Yasuke-only, and Quick Time Events can be set to Auto in the Gameplay settings.

steps.text: As Yasuke start any kata on the map and complete the timed sequence.

achievements.summary: Complete all twenty-two Kuji-kiri meditations.

guide.context: Kuji-kiri are Naoe-only, and Quick Time Events can be set to Auto in the Gameplay settings.

steps.text: Complete every meditation spot: five in Izumi-Settsu, three in Yamashiro and two each in Omi, Iga, Harima, Yamato, Kii, Tamba and Wakasa.

achievements.summary: Complete all five legendary sumi-e.

guide.context: Legendary sumi-e are season and time gated, and a brush icon appears on the compass when you are close.

collectibles.name: Legendary macaques
collectibles.method: On any season at night, take the stairs up from the shrine and sketch the monkeys beside the statue.

collectibles.name: Legendary grey heron
collectibles.method: On a winter day, sketch the grey heron at the centre of the island.

collectibles.name: Legendary deer
collectibles.method: On a spring night, sketch the legendary deer on its rock ledge in Yoshino.

collectibles.name: Legendary white tanuki
collectibles.method: On a summer day, approach from the forest side and sketch the white tanuki before it flees.

collectibles.name: Legendary silver fox
collectibles.location: @loc{Kamimisu Inari Shrine} on the Nakahechi Road, Kii
collectibles.method: On an autumn night, sketch the silver fox at the shrine.

achievements.summary: Complete the seven tea bowl collection for Sen no Rikyu.

guide.context: The quest opens after the Shinbakufu target The Golden Teppo falls. Six bowls cost 125 mon each; the seventh is a story reward.

collectibles.name: Intricate Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy from the decor merchant east of Sakai Port for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Rustic Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy from the decor merchant near Kyoto's southern edge for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Sophisticated Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy from the decor merchant north of @loc{Shingu Shrine} for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Unique Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy from the decor merchant near central Sakamoto for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Elegant Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy at the Kara market near the north-east bridge of the southern island for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Simple Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Buy from the decor merchant near Kameyama's southern edge for 125 mon.

collectibles.name: Classic Tea Bowls
collectibles.method: Receive the final bowl by defeating the Shinbakufu target @enemy{The Wise}.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Hideout.

steps.text: Play into Act 1 until Naoe is granted the Hideout, then place your first building.

achievements.description: Add a sumi-e to the Hideout
achievements.summary: Display a sumi-e painting in the Hideout.

steps.text: Build the @loc{Study} in the Hideout and open its placement menu.
Place any sumi-e painting on the wall.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a building in the Hideout
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade one Hideout building.

steps.text: Pick one Hideout building and upgrade it to level 3.

achievements.summary: Adopt a pet for the Hideout.

guide.context: Petting or sketching any animal unlocks the pet tab in build mode.

steps.text: Pet an animal in the world, then open Hideout build mode, switch to the Animals tab and place it on the grounds.

achievements.description: Reach the highest point on the map
achievements.summary: Reach the highest point on the map.

guide.context: The summit is the Mount Hakkyo viewpoint in eastern Yamato, on the border with Kii.

steps.text: Climb @loc{Mount Hakkyo} and step onto the highest ledge.

achievements.description: Visit every province on the map
achievements.summary: Visit all nine provinces.

guide.context: Only the nine provinces count; sub-regions do not matter.

steps.text: Travel into Izumi-Settsu, Kii, Yamato, Iga, Omi, Wakasa, Tamba, Harima and Yamashiro until the province banner appears for each.

achievements.summary: Gather information with a scout.

guide.context: Guided Exploration must be switched off, or targets mark themselves and the scout step never triggers.

steps.text: After unlocking the Hideout, track an Objective Board quest, press F to select a scout and send it to the hinted area to reveal the target marker.

achievements.description: Complete a contract in each province
achievements.summary: Complete one contract in each of the nine provinces.

guide.context: Kakurega safehouses must be bought with mon, and destroy-object contracts are the quickest.

steps.text: Buy a @loc{Kakurega} in every province, then complete one contract from each safehouse board.

achievements.summary: Find the treasure behind the Hideout waterfall.

steps.text: Go to the waterfall on the east side of the Hideout and walk into the cave hidden behind the water.

achievements.summary: Complete the Seta River Killers questline.

guide.context: The chain was added in Title Update 1.0.6 and starts at the Hideout.

steps.text: Start @loc{Fateful Encounter} from the Hideout to open the Seta River Killers target circle.
Clear the circle, then follow @loc{Hunters Hunted} and Rufino's remaining quests to the end of the chain.

achievements.summary: Reach Level 80.

guide.context: Level 80 is not reachable in one playthrough; target kills and outpost clears give the most experience on New Game+.

steps.text: Keep playing New Game+, clearing targets and outposts until your character reaches level 80.

achievements.summary: Reach Knowledge Rank 10.

guide.context: Knowledge comes from temples, kata, Kuji-kiri, paths and crypts, and the total needs a near-complete New Game+ clear.

steps.text: Complete the orange knowledge activities across the map, including New Game+ regions, until Knowledge Rank 10.

achievements.summary: Obtain two golden katanas.

guide.context: The katanas are handed out at the end of each character's personal story in a New Game+ cycle.

steps.text: Start New Game+ and complete both Naoe's and Yasuke's personal story lines to receive the two golden katanas.

achievements.summary: Escape Sumoto Castle in the Claws of Awaji story.

guide.context: The expansion starts by speaking to the woman in the Hideout after finishing @loc{Out of the Shadows}.

steps.text: Begin the Claws of Awaji opening quest and escape @loc{Sumoto Castle}.

achievements.summary: Defeat all three of Yukari's taisho in Claws of Awaji.

guide.context: The three leaders head the target circles around Awaji.

steps.text: Progress the Awaji story and defeat the three taisho leading Yukari's circles.

achievements.summary: Return the Imperial Regalia to the Emperor.

steps.text: Finish the Claws of Awaji main story and return the Imperial Regalia.

achievements.description: Eliminate all targets in Awaji (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Eliminate every target in Awaji.

guide.context: The four target circles open as the DLC story progresses.

steps.text: Clear the Sandozoku-ippa, Tomedji's Men, Yasuhira's Scouts and Novaki Raiders circles.
After the last target falls, report to @npc{Konatsu} at the Sumoto base.

achievements.description: Equip a Legendary Bo (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Equip a legendary Bo.

guide.context: The Bo master teaches the weapon during the DLC story.

steps.text: Play the DLC to the Bo training scene, where a legendary Bo is equipped automatically.

achievements.description: Eliminate an enemy after using all three postures of the Bo in a single combat (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Eliminate an enemy after using all three Bo postures in one fight.

guide.context: Postures are switched while charging an attack; hold the attack and move the aim control up or down.

steps.text: Fight one enemy and land a hit in the middle, high and low Bo postures.
Kill that same enemy.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with one single Wind Slash strike (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies with one Wind Slash strike.

guide.context: Wind Slash is an Okatana skill; weaken the group before activating it.

steps.text: Group five weak enemies, damage them first, then kill all five with a single Wind Slash; the @loc{Azuchi Castle} training ground has plenty of soldiers.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a dropped tezutsu.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with the tezutsu you drop after being hit.

guide.context: Requires the Tezutsu Flash skill in Yasuke's Teppo tree.

steps.text: As Yasuke reduce a large enemy to low health, then activate @mechanic{Tezutsu Flash}.
Let that enemy hit you so the tezutsu falls, then let its explosion finish the enemy.

achievements.description: Eliminate 7 enemies through one single use of Windstep (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Eliminate seven enemies during one Windstep activation.

guide.context: Windstep is a Bo skill; buy its damage and duration upgrades first.

steps.text: Lower the difficulty, group a crowd of enemies and eliminate seven during a single Windstep activation.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Old Ashigaru in Yura.

guide.context: Level your gear first and use a defensive ability such as Impervious Defense in the Samurai tree.

steps.text: In @loc{Yura}, board the large boat and defeat the Old Ashigaru.

achievements.description: Complete all Landscape Sumi-e in Awaji (Claws of Awaji)
achievements.summary: Complete all three Landscape Sumi-e on Awaji.

guide.context: After escaping Sumoto Castle, Junjiro gives the quest that marks all three drawings on the island map.

collectibles.name: Eshima Landscape Sumi-e
collectibles.method: Draw the landscape at the Eshima Trail vista.

collectibles.name: Izanagi Shrine Landscape Sumi-e
collectibles.method: Draw the landscape at the shrine.

collectibles.name: Naruto Whirlpool Landscape Sumi-e
collectibles.method: Draw the landscape at the whirlpool viewpoint.

achievements.summary: Reach Hideout level 13.

guide.context: Hideout level 13 requires every main and thematic room at maximum level.

steps.text: Upgrade all Hideout rooms to their highest level until the Hideout reaches level 13.

achievements.summary: Train Kinu and Kane.

guide.context: The brothers need a day to heal between quests; a level 2 Nando room lets you skip time.

steps.text: Start @loc{A Puzzlement} on the map, equip the riddle scroll pointer and follow the symbol.
Finish the three follow-up training quests, waiting a day between each.

achievements.summary: Complete five Corrupted Castles.

guide.context: Corrupted Castles appear after level 30 once more than three castles are cleared, at the end of a season, with a multicoloured icon.

steps.text: Clear a Corrupted Castle by killing its samurai daisho and opening the chest, then repeat until five are done.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Templars in the Black Tides story arc.

guide.context: Prerequisites are the finished Naoe and Yasuke main story plus two earlier free quests, namely @loc{A Critical Encounter} and @loc{A Puzzlement}.

steps.text: Approach the quest marker at @loc{Yuasa} in south-western Kii to start the arc.
Follow the @loc{Black Tides} quest chain to its final fight against the Templar duo.

achievements.summary: Activate an Exploit from the Domain Exploit Tree.

guide.context: Domains unlock at level 30 once the main story is finished.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{MOD} at the Hidden River in Yamato and enter the nearby rift.
Clear the first Domain to earn enough MODcoins, then buy any Exploit from the Exploit Tree.

achievements.summary: Complete a Challenge Level 10 Domain.

guide.context: Challenge levels unlock in order, and the level 10 Domain is Nightmare difficulty with level 100 enemies.

steps.text: Clear Domain challenge levels 1 through 9 in order to unlock level 10.
Complete the Challenge Level 10 Domain; reach near level 100 first if the fights are too hard.
